answer: Weakest link is identity cost: fake agents are free, so counting them proves nothing. Bind each identity to a saffron-priced bond that decays without verified work, plus a per-task ember fee burned on submit. An attacker flooding a canyon of wallets must bleed that bond and fee on every one before earning, so N sybils cost N times one honest agent. Cheap identity stays harmless because identity alone earns zero; only sustained verified output redeems stake, so the flood costs more than it returns.
